subtitle.en: Apex Executive Governance, Statutory Authorities, and Central Administrative Machinery of Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth, Rahuri
subtitle.mr: महात्मा फुले कृषि विद्यापीठ राहुरी चे सर्वोच्च प्रशासकीय संचलन, वैधानिक प्राधिकरणे व मध्यवर्ती प्रशासकीय रचना

text.en: The administration of Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth, Rahuri is governed under the statutory provisions of the Maharashtra Agricultural Universities (Krishi Vidyapeeths) Act, 1983 and its unified statutes. The Hon. Governor of Maharashtra serves as the Chancellor of the University, and the Hon. Minister for Agriculture, Government of Maharashtra serves as the Pro-Chancellor.
text.mr: महात्मा फुले कृषि विद्यापीठ, राहुरी चे प्रशासन महाराष्ट्र कृषि विद्यापीठे कायदा, १९८३ आणि परिनियमांनुसार चालविले जाते. महाराष्ट्राचे माननीय राज्यपाल हे विद्यापीठाचे कुलपती (Chancellor) असून माननीय कृषिमंत्री हे कुलपती-उपाध्यक्ष (Pro-Chancellor) आहेत.

text.en: The Hon. Vice-Chancellor is the principal executive and academic officer of the University, supported by the Registrar, Comptroller, Director of Research, Director of Extension Education, Dean (Faculty of Agriculture), and University Engineer in carrying out the university mandate of Education, Research, and Extension.
text.mr: माननीय कुलगुरू हे विद्यापीठाचे मुख्य कार्यकारी व शैक्षणिक प्रमुख आहेत. त्यांच्या मार्गदर्शनाखाली कुलसचिव, नियंत्रक (वित्त), संचालक संशोधन, संचालक विस्तार शिक्षण, अधिष्ठाता (कृषि) आणि विद्यापीठ अभियंता हे प्रशासन, संशोधन, शिक्षण व विस्तार कार्याचे प्रभावी संचलन करतात.

introduction.historyEn: The Indian National Agricultural Research System (NARS) with its nationwide network of educational and research institutions consisting of state agricultural universities, zonal research stations, and ICAR institutes established the Agricultural Research Information System (ARIS) in 1996-97 to strengthen research information under the National Agricultural Research Project (NARP). Further, the ARIS Cell was renamed as Agricultural Knowledge Management Unit (AKMU) as per ICAR guidelines (F.No. 3-1/2010-GAS (DIPA) dtd. 27 January, 2011).
introduction.historyMr: भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कृषी संशोधन प्रणाली (NARS) अंतर्गत राज्य कृषी विद्यापीठे, विभागीय संशोधन केंद्रे आणि ICAR संस्थांमधील संशोधन माहिती प्रणाली बळकट करण्यासाठी १९९६-९७ मध्ये राष्ट्रीय कृषी संशोधन प्रकल्पांतर्गत (NARP) 'कृषी संशोधन माहिती प्रणाली' (ARIS) कक्षाची स्थापना करण्यात आली. पुढे २७ जानेवारी २०११ च्या ICAR मार्गदर्शक तत्त्वांनुसार (F.No. 3-1/2010-GAS (DIPA)) या कक्षाचे नामकरण 'कृषी ज्ञान व्यवस्थापन केंद्र' (AKMU) असे करण्यात आले.
introduction.infrastructureEn: The Unit is entrusted with developing ICT in agricultural research, maintaining the University's campus network, official website (mpkv.ac.in), centralized server hosting, firewall security, and web server administration. AKMU is connected to all academic, administrative, and research buildings in the central campus through Optical Fibre Cabling (OFC). At present, AKMU is provided with 1 Gbps National Knowledge Network (NKN) internet connectivity (www.nkn.in) through BSNL, shared across all divisions and sections of Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth, Rahuri.
introduction.infrastructureMr: कृषी संशोधनात माहिती व संप्रेषण तंत्रज्ञानाचा (ICT) विकास, विद्यापीठाचे अंतर्गत नेटवर्क व्यवस्थापन, अधिकृत संकेतस्थळ (mpkv.ac.in), सर्व्हर होस्टिंग आणि सायबर सुरक्षा यांची जबाबदारी AKMU पार पाडते. मध्यवर्ती आवारातील सर्व इमारती ऑप्टिकल फायबर केबलने (OFC) जोडलेल्या असून BSNL मार्फत १ Gbps क्षमतेची राष्ट्रीय ज्ञान नेटवर्क (NKN) इंटरनेट सुविधा सर्व विभागांना पुरविली जाते.

title.mr: विद्यापीठ ग्रंथालयाविषयी

subtitle.en: Started functioning at MPKV Central Campus in 1968 with 2,070 books; expanding through the 1980 dedicated 3,740 sq.mt. building and 2012 ICAR grant extension.
subtitle.mr: १९६८ मध्ये मुख्य संकुलात २,०७० पुस्तकांसह सुरू झालेले विद्यापीठ ग्रंथालय; १९८० मधील ३,७४० चौ.मी. इमारत व २०१२ मधील ICAR अनुदान विस्तारासह ज्ञानसेवेत कार्यरत.

body.en: Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth is one of the best universities among Maharashtra with a mandate of agricultural education, research and extension. Libraries play pivotal role in dissemination of knowledge and information to the students, readers in their education, research and extension activities. In order to cater the needs of the readers, the University Library, started functioning at Central Campus in the year 1968 with a merge collection of 2070 books only. It is developing steadily under the able guidance of Vice-Chancellor and Chairmanship of Library Advisory Committee and rendering various services to the readers, scientists, teachers, students etc. since last fifty years.
body.mr: महात्मा फुले कृषि विद्यापीठ हे कृषी शिक्षण, संशोधन आणि विस्तार कार्य करणारे महाराष्ट्रातील एक अग्रगण्य विद्यापीठ आहे. विद्यार्थी व वाचकांच्या शिक्षण, संशोधन आणि विस्तार कार्यात ज्ञान व माहितीचा प्रसार करण्यात ग्रंथालय महत्त्वाची भूमिका बजावते. वाचकांच्या गरजा पूर्ण करण्यासाठी विद्यापीठ ग्रंथालय १९६८ मध्ये मुख्य संकुलात केवळ २,०७० पुस्तकांच्या संग्रहासह सुरू झाले. कुलगुरूंच्या सक्षम मार्गदर्शनाखाली आणि ग्रंथालय सल्लागार समितीच्या अध्यक्षतेखाली ते सातत्याने विकसित होत असून गेल्या पन्नास वर्षांहून अधिक काळ वाचक, शास्त्रज्ञ, शिक्षक आणि विद्यार्थ्यांना विविध सेवा देत आहे.

body.en: Due to huge collection of books and documents, a beautiful and impressive separate building was constructed in 1980 with 3740 sq.mt. Carpet area. The library was shifted in the newly constructed building in December, 1980. The building is having length of 117 ft and the width of 130 ft. Extension of University Library building completed from the 100 crores grants received by ICAR in 2012. Two Sections viz: Reference Section & Theses Section shifted in new extended building by which sitting capacity of 150 readers increased. The University Library is kept open for usages from 9.00 to 21.00 hrs throughout the years except Sundays and Holidays. The University Library has also provided Reading Room Facility to the students, which is kept open from 9.00 to 23.00 hrs.
body.mr: पुस्तके आणि दस्तऐवजांच्या मोठ्या संग्रहामुळे १९८० मध्ये ३,७४० चौ.मी. कार्पेट क्षेत्रफळाची भव्य आणि स्वतंत्र इमारत बांधण्यात आली. डिसेंबर १९८० मध्ये ग्रंथालय नवीन इमारतीत स्थलांतरित केले गेले. इमारतीची लांबी ११७ फूट आणि रुंदी १३० फूट आहे. २०१२ मध्ये ICAR कडून प्राप्त झालेल्या ₹१०० कोटी अनुदानातून ग्रंथालय इमारतीचा विस्तार पूर्ण झाला. नवीन विस्तारित इमारतीत संदर्भ विभाग (Reference Section) व प्रबंध विभाग (Theses Section) स्थलांतरित करण्यात आले, ज्यामुळे १५० वाचकांची आसनक्षमता वाढली. रविवार आणि सुट्ट्या वगळता विद्यापीठ ग्रंथालय वर्षभर सकाळी ९.०० ते रात्री २१.०० वाजेपर्यंत खुले असते. विद्यार्थ्यांसाठी अभ्यासिका सुविधा (Reading Room Facility) सकाळी ९.०० ते रात्री २३.०० वाजेपर्यंत सुरू असते.

title.en: Attendance & Examination Eligibility
title.mr: हजेरी व परीक्षा पात्रता

points.en: Minimum 80% attendance in both theory and practicals separately is mandatory to appear for semester end examinations.
points.mr: सत्रांत परीक्षेसाठी प्रत्येक विषयाच्या लेखी व प्रात्यक्षिक वर्गात स्वतंत्रपणे किमान ८०% हजेरी असणे अनिवार्य आहे.

points.en: In genuine medical illness or official university sports/NSS deputation, a condolence up to 10% may be granted by Dean.
points.mr: वैद्यकीय कारणे किंवा अधिकृत क्रीडा/रासेयो सहभागासाठी अधिष्ठात्यांच्या मान्यतेने कमाल १०% सवलत दिली जाऊ शकते.

points.en: Students falling below 70% attendance are treated as deregistered and must re-register the course when offered.
points.mr: ७०% पेक्षा कमी हजेरी असणाऱ्या विद्यार्थ्यांना त्या विषयातून वगळले जाते व त्यांना तो विषय पुन्हा लावावा लागतो.

title.en: Grading Scale & CGPA Calculation
title.mr: गुणदान पद्धती व CGPA सूत्र

points.en: 10-point scale grading system: Grade Point = Marks obtained out of 100 divided by 10.
points.mr: १०-गुणी मूल्यमापन पद्धती: १०० पैकी मिळालेल्या गुणांना १० ने भागून ग्रेड पॉईंट निश्चित केला जातो.

points.en: Minimum Grade Point required to pass a course is 5.00 out of 10.00 for UG and 6.50 for PG/Ph.D.
points.mr: विषय उत्तीर्ण होण्यासाठी पदवी स्तरावर किमान ५.०० ग्रेड पॉईंट आणि पदव्युत्तर/पीएच.डी. स्तरावर ६.५० गुण आवश्यक आहेत.

points.en: Overall Grade Point Average (OGPA) of 6.00 and above qualifies for Second Class; 7.00+ for First Class; 8.00+ for Distinction.
points.mr: OGPA ६.०० वर द्वितीय श्रेणी, ७.०० वर प्रथम श्रेणी आणि ८.०० पेक्षा जास्त गुणांवर विशेष प्रावीण्य (Distinction) दिले जाते.

title.en: Student Code of Conduct & Anti-Ragging
title.mr: विद्यार्थी आचारसंहिता व रॅगिंग प्रतिबंध

points.en: Zero tolerance for ragging under Maharashtra Prohibition of Ragging Act, 1999 with immediate police reporting & expulsion.
points.mr: महाराष्ट्र रॅगिंग प्रतिबंधक कायदा १९९९ नुसार रॅगिंगला पूर्णतः बंदी असून गुन्हा सिद्ध झाल्यास तात्काळ निष्कासन व पोलीस कारवाई होते.

points.en: Mandatory anti-ragging affidavit submission on UGC/ICAR portal during admission registration.
points.mr: प्रवेशाच्या वेळी प्रत्येक विद्यार्थ्याने व पालकांनी यूजीसी/आयसीएआर पोर्टलवर रॅगिंगविरोधी प्रतिज्ञापत्र देणे सक्तीचे आहे.

points.en: College Anti-Ragging Squad conducts 24x7 surprise checks in hostels, messes, and campus premises.
points.mr: महाविद्यालयीन अँटी-रॅगिंग पथकामार्फत वसतिगृहे, मेस व संकुलात २४x७ नियमित व आकस्मिक तपासणी केली जाते.

name.en: Office of the Director of Instruction

message.en: The Directorate of Instruction shoulders the crucial responsibility of academic leadership, curricula development, accreditation maintenance, and educational coordination across all constituent and affiliated colleges. Our goal is to empower young minds with scientific inquiry and technical expertise for sustainable agriculture.
message.mr: शिक्षण संचालनालय विद्यापीठाच्या सर्व घटक व संलग्न महाविद्यालये आणि तंत्र विद्यालयांमधील अभ्यासक्रम रचना, शैक्षणिक गुणवत्ता, अधिस्वीकृती आणि समन्वयाची जबाबदारी सांभाळते. कृषि क्षेत्राच्या शाश्वत विकासासाठी युवा पिढीला आधुनिक ज्ञान आणि कौशल्याने सुसज्ज करणे हे आमचे ध्येय आहे.

text.en: Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth, Rahuri is the first State Agriculture University in Maharashtra established in 1969 having its jurisdiction in 10 districts of Western Maharashtra. Director of Instruction shoulders the responsibility of leading the education of the University.
text.mr: महात्मा फुले कृषि विद्यापीठ, राहुरी हे महाराष्ट्रातील पहिले राज्य कृषि विद्यापीठ असून त्याची स्थापना २९ मार्च १९६८ रोजी झाली. विद्यापीठाचे कार्यक्षेत्र पश्चिम महाराष्ट्रातील १० जिल्ह्यांमध्ये पसरलेले असून शिक्षण संचालक विद्यापीठाच्या शैक्षणिक उपक्रमांचे नेतृत्व करतात.

text.en: The mandate is to provide Diploma, Graduate, Post-graduate and Doctorate level quality education in agriculture and allied fields for skill development and producing the competent human resource.
text.mr: कृषि व संलग्न विद्याशाखांमध्ये पदविका, पदवी, पदव्युत्तर व आचार्य पदवी स्तरावर उच्च दर्जाचे शिक्षण देणे, कौशल्य विकास साधणे आणि देशासाठी सक्षम कृषि मनुष्यबळ निर्माण करणे हा विद्यापीठाचा मुख्य उद्देश आहे.

text.en: The University offers various educational programmes viz., Under graduate [B.Sc. (Hons) Agriculture, B.Sc. (Hons) Horticulture, B. Tech. (Agricultural Engineering), B.Tech. (Biotechnology), B. Tech. (Food Technology) and B.Sc. (Hons) Agri. Business Management], Post-graduate (M.Sc. (Agri.) and Ph.D.), and Diploma in Agriculture.
text.mr: विद्यापीठामार्फत पदवी स्तरावर बी.एस्सी. (कृषि), बी.एस्सी. (उद्यानविद्या), बी.टेक. (कृषि अभियांत्रिकी), बी.टेक. (जैवतंत्रज्ञान), बी.टेक. (अन्नतंत्रज्ञान) व बी.एस्सी. (कृषि व्यवसाय व्यवस्थापन), पदव्युत्तर स्तरावर एम.एस्सी., एम.टेक., एम.बी.ए. आणि आचार्य पदवी (पीएच.डी.) चे शिक्षण दिले जाते.

text.en: The University has fourteen under-graduate constituent colleges out of which eight colleges of agriculture sciences located at Pune, Kolhapur, Dhule, Nandurbar, Karad, Muktainagar, Halgaon and Kashti, Malegaon; two agricultural engineering colleges at Rahuri and Kashti, Malegaon; two colleges for horticulture at Pune and Kashti; and one each agriculture business management and food technology college at Kashti, Malegaon.
text.mr: विद्यापीठाची १४ घटक महाविद्यालये असून यामध्ये पुणे, कोल्हापूर, धुळे, नंदुरबार, कराड, मुक्ताईनगर, हळगाव आणि काष्टी (मालेगाव) येथील ८ कृषि महाविद्यालये, राहुरी व काष्टी येथील २ कृषि अभियांत्रिकी महाविद्यालये, पुणे व काष्टी येथील २ उद्यानविद्या महाविद्यालये आणि काष्टी येथील अन्नतंत्रज्ञान व कृषि व्यवसाय व्यवस्थापन महाविद्यालयांचा समावेश आहे.

text.en: National Agricultural Education Accreditation Board (NAEAB) has granted accreditation to MPKV, Rahuri and its constituent colleges for five years (2023-24 to 2027-28) with an ‘A’ grade and score of 3.12 out of 4.0.
text.mr: राष्ट्रीय कृषि शिक्षण अधिस्वीकृती मंडळ (NAEAB - भा.कृ.अनु.प.) द्वारे मफुकृवि राहुरी आणि तिच्या घटक महाविद्यालयांना २०२३-२४ ते २०२७-२८ या ५ वर्षांच्या कालावधीसाठी ४ पैकी ३.१२ गुणांसह ‘अ’ (A) श्रेणी अधिस्वीकृती प्रदान करण्यात आली आहे.

text.en: Since inception, the University has produced more than one lakh skilled human resource engaged in various public, private, administrative, and research agricultural sectors globally.
text.mr: स्थापनेपासून आतापर्यंत विद्यापीठाने १ लाखांपेक्षा अधिक पदवीधर व तंत्रकुशल मनुष्यबळ घडविले असून ते शासकीय, प्रशासकीय, संशोधन, बँकिंग आणि कॉर्पोरेट कृषी क्षेत्रात राष्ट्रीय व आंतरराष्ट्रीय स्तरावर उल्लेखनीय योगदान देत आहेत.

faqs.qEn: When and how should university pensioners submit the annual Life Certificate (हयातीचा दाखला)?
faqs.qMr: विद्यापीठ निवृत्तीवेतनधारकांनी वार्षिक हयातीचा दाखला कधी व कसा सादर करावा?
faqs.aEn: Every retiree or family pensioner must submit the Life Certificate in the month of November each year. It can be submitted physically at the Pension Cell / disbursing bank branch, or digitally through the Government of India Jeevan Pramaan portal using biometric Aadhaar authentication.
faqs.aMr: सर्व निवृत्तीवेतनधारक व कुटुंब निवृत्तीवेतनधारकांनी दरवर्षी १ ते ३० नोव्हेंबर दरम्यान हयातीचा दाखला सादर करणे अनिवार्य आहे. हा दाखला प्रत्यक्ष बँकेत अथवा पेन्शन कक्षात जाऊन किंवा 'जीवन प्रमाण' (Jeevan Pramaan) पोर्टलद्वारे बायोमेट्रिक आधारे डिजिटल स्वरूपात सादर करता येतो.

faqs.qEn: What is the procedure for obtaining up to 40% Commutation of Pension?
faqs.qMr: निवृत्तीवेतनाचे ४०% पर्यंत अंशराशीकरण (Commutation) मिळविण्याची काय पद्धत आहे?
faqs.aEn: An employee retiring on superannuation may apply for commutation up to 40% of basic pension within one year of retirement without medical examination. The application in the prescribed format should be submitted to the Pension Cell through the respective Head of Office.
faqs.aMr: वयोमर्यादेनुसार सेवानिवृत्त होणारा कर्मचारी सेवानिवृत्तीच्या १ वर्षाच्या आत वैद्यकीय तपासणीशिवाय कमाल ४०% पर्यंत मूळ निवृत्तीवेतनाचे अंशराशीकरण करू शकतो. यासाठी विहित नमुन्यातील अर्ज संबंधित कार्यालय प्रमुखांमार्फत नियंत्रक कार्यालयातील पेन्शन कक्षाकडे सादर करावा लागतो.

faqs.qEn: How is the General Provident Fund (GPF) final balance settled after retirement?
faqs.qMr: सेवानिवृत्तीनंतर भविष्य निर्वाह निधी (GPF) ची अंतिम शिल्लक रक्कम कशी मिळते?
faqs.aEn: Three months prior to the date of retirement, the employee should submit Form 'B' along with the last credit slip to the Comptroller Office. The final payment order including up-to-date interest is issued promptly on the date of superannuation.
faqs.aMr: सेवानिवृत्तीच्या दिनांकापूर्वी ३ महिने अगोदर कर्मचाऱ्याने विहित 'ब' नमुन्यातील अर्ज व चालू आर्थिक वर्षाचे वर्गणी विवरण पत्रक नियंत्रक कार्यालयास सादर करावे. सेवानिवृत्तीच्या दिवशी संपूर्ण व्याजासह अंतिम रकमेचा धनादेश/खात्यात हस्तांतरण आदेश जारी केला जातो.

faqs.qEn: What are the deadlines and proforma for Annual Performance Appraisal Reports (APAR)?
faqs.qMr: वार्षिक गोपनीय अहवाल (APAR) सादर करण्याची मुदत व कार्यपद्धती काय आहे?
faqs.aEn: Every employee must submit their self-appraisal by 15th April for the preceding financial year. The Reporting Officer completes evaluation by 31st May, and the Reviewing Authority finalizes grades by 30th June for inclusion in the official dossier.
faqs.aMr: प्रत्येक कर्मचाऱ्याने वित्तीय वर्ष संपल्यानंतर १५ एप्रिलपर्यंत आपला स्वयंकूल्यांकन अहवाल सादर करणे आवश्यक आहे. प्रतिवेदन अधिकाऱ्याने ३१ मे पर्यंत व पुनर्विलोकन अधिकाऱ्याने ३० जूनपर्यंत मूल्यमापन पूर्ण करून कुलसचिव आस्थापना विभागाकडे सादर करणे बंधनकारक असते.

foundationDay.descriptionEn: Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth, Rahuri was established on March 29, 1968 under the Maharashtra Agricultural Universities Act. Every year, March 29th is celebrated with immense fervor as Foundation Day, honoring progressive farmers, distinguished scientists, and alumni achievers.

Every July during Van Mahotsav, university students, faculty, and farm workers plant over 50,000 indigenous trees to combat climate change and maintain biodiversity.

retrospection.descriptionEn: MAGOVA is a premier annual introspection convention organized at the Central Campus, Rahuri during late December / first week of January. The Vice Chancellor, Directors, Deans, and Heads of Departments review annual progress in education, varietal development, externally funded research, technology transfer, and administrative reforms.
retrospection.descriptionMr: 'मगोवा' ही विद्यापीठाची वार्षिक सर्वंकष विचारमंथन परिषद असून दरवर्षी डिसेंबर अखेर अथवा जानेवारीच्या पहिल्या आठवड्यात आयोजित केली जाते. यामध्ये शिक्षण, संशोधन, विस्तार शिक्षण, कृषी अभियांत्रिकी व प्रशासनातील प्रगतीचा सूक्ष्म आढावा घेऊन आगामी वर्षाचे धोरण ठरविले जाते.

kisanAadhar.descriptionEn: Kisan Aadhar Sammelan is a flagship mega state farmers convention organized annually since 2017 jointly by Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth, Rahuri and the Department of Agriculture, Government of Maharashtra (along with ATMA Ahmednagar). It features high-tech agricultural exhibitions, live crop demonstrations, cattle shows, farmers-scientists interaction workshops, and seed distribution.
kisanAadhar.descriptionMr: महात्मा फुले कृषी विद्यापीठ, राहुरी आणि कृषी विभाग, महाराष्ट्र शासन (व आत्मा अहमदनगर) यांच्या संयुक्त विद्यमाने २०१७ पासून भव्य 'किसान आधार संमेलन' आयोजित केले जाते. यामध्ये अत्याधुनिक कृषी प्रदर्शन, विविध पिकांचे जिवंत प्रक्षेत्र प्रात्यक्षिके, पशुप्रदर्शन, शेतकरी-शास्त्रज्ञ चर्चासत्रे व उन्नत बी-बियाणे वाटप केले जाते.

text.en: State Agricultural Universities in Maharashtra and Maharashtra Council of Agriculture Education and Research (MCAER) Pune are jointly organizes Joint AGRESCO every year on rotational basis. Recently, 47th Joint AGRESCO Meet was organized at Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyappeeth, Rahuri on 29-31 May, 2019. The inaugural function was Chaired by Dr. K. P. Viswanath, Hon’ble Vice Chancellor, MPKV, Rahuri while Shri Chandrakant Patil, Hon’ble Minister of Revenue, Agriculture, PWD (excluding undertakings) and Relief & Rehabilitation of Maharashtra State was the Chairman for concluding session. In 47th Joint AGRESCO Meet 2019, 08 crop varieties, 01 farm implement and machineries, and 5 abiotic resistant sources of plant varieties and 47 production technologies developed by Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth, Rahuri were accepted and release for benefits of farming community.

In 47th Joint AGRESCO Meet 2019, 08 crop varieties, 01 farm implement and machineries, and 5 abiotic resistant sources of plant varieties and 47 production technologies developed by Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth, Rahuri were accepted and release for benefits of farming community.

text.en: State Agricultural Universities in Maharashtra and Maharashtra Council of Agriculture Education and Research (MCAER) Pune are jointly organizes Joint AGRESCO every year on rotational basis. In context of pandemic spread of COVID-19 disease, 48th Joint AGRESCO Meet was organized on virtual mode during on 27-31 October, 2020. The Hon’ble Chief Minister, Maharashtra State Shri Uddhavjee Thackeray inaugurated the Joint Agresco Meet. Shri Dadajee Bhuse, Hon’ble Minister of Agriculture, Maharashtra State. Shri Sanjayjee Dhotre, Minister of State for Electronics and Information Technology Government of India was also joined the inaugural function. The valedictory function was Chaired by Shri Dadajee Bhuse, Hon’ble Minister of Agriculture, Maharashtra State. In 48th Joint AGRESCO Meet 2020, 07 crop varieties, 03 farm implement and machineries, and 59 production technologies developed by Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth, Rahuri were accepted and release for benefits of farming community.
text.mr: State Agricultural Universities in Maharashtra and Maharashtra Council of Agriculture Education and Research (MCAER) Pune are jointly organizes Joint AGRESCO every year on rotational basis. In context of pandemic spread of COVID-19 disease, 48th Joint AGRESCO Meet was organized on virtual mode during on 27-31 October, 2020. The Hon’ble Chief Minister, Maharashtra State Shri Uddhavjee Thackeray inaugurated the Joint Agresco Meet. Shri Dadajee Bhuse, Hon’ble Minister of Agriculture, Maharashtra State. text.en: A Green Campus and Clan Campus is a place where environmental friendly practices and education combine to promote sustainable and eco-friendly practices in the campus. Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth, Rahuri is incorporating these strategies into the institutional planning processes with the aim of develop a clean and green campus. On this line this university is celebrating 1st July as a Krishidin and also organizing the massive tree plantation programme under the university jurisdiction every year. The tree plantation initiative includes neem, jamun, mango, bamboo, karanj, aonla, hirda, behada, kagzi lime and various medicinal plants.

text.en: A massive tree plantation programme Vanmohotsav -2017 and Krishidin was organized on July 01, 2017 at MPKV, Rahuri. The programme was chaired by Dr. K. P. Viswanatha, Vice Chancellor, MPKV, Rahuri. Dr. V. P. Chahal, ADG (AE), ICAR, New Delhi, Dr. Lakhan Singh, Director, ICAR-ATARI, Zone-VIII, Pune were the chief guests. Dr. K. D. Kokate, Director, Extension Education, Dr. R.S. Patil, Director of Research and other university authorities guided the scientists, staff, students. In all 52 Plantation Groups were formed and more than one thousand University staff including scientists, supporting staff etc. participated in the plantation programme.

text.en: A massive tree plantation programme Vanmohotsav -2018 and Krishidin was organized on July 02, 2018 at the Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth, Rahuri to celebrate the birth anniversary of former Chief Minister of Maharashtra late Vasantrao Naik. Dr. K. P. Viswanatha, Vice Chancellor, MPKV, Rahuri presided over the function. Shri. Adarsha Reddy, District Conservator of Forests, Ahmednagar was the chief guest. Dr. K. D. Kokate, Director, Extension Education, Dr. S. R. Gadakh, Director of Research, Mrs. Kirti Jamdhade, Divisional Forest Officer, Shri. Anil Dound, Tahsildar, Rahuri, Registrar Dr. D. D. Pawar, Comptroller Shri. Vijay Kote, Shri. Pandit Lonare, District Superintendent Agricultural Officer, Ahmednagar were present for the programme. After the programme, the university staff and students planted around 23,655 trees at the central campus. These include neem, jamun, mango, bamboo, karanj, aonla, hirda, behada, kagzi lime and various medicinal plants. A target of 1,06,182 trees for planting this year has been set by the university in its ten district jurisdiction.

text.en: On the eve of birthday anniversary of Former Chief Minister, Maharashtra state Late Shri. Vasantrao Naik has been celebrated as a Krishi Din on 1st July. On this occasion a tree plantation programme was organized under the able guidance of Hon’ble Vice Chancellor Dr. P. G. Patil on July 27, 2023 at CC MPKV Rahuri. Shri. Sachin Kand, Regional Forest Officer, Social Forest Dept. Ahmednagar, was the chief guest. Director of Research Dr.  S.D. Gorantiwar, Dean (F/A) Dr. S.A. text.en: A massive tree plantation programme Vanmohotsav -2018 and Krishidin was organized on July 02, 2018 at the Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth, Rahuri to celebrate the birth anniversary of former Chief Minister of Maharashtra late Vasantrao Naik. Dr. K. P. Viswanatha, Vice Chancellor, MPKV, Rahuri presided over the function. Shri. Adarsha Reddy, District Conservator of Forests, Ahmednagar was the chief guest. Dr. K. D. text.en: The Farmer FIRST Programme (FFP) is an ICAR initiative to move beyond the production and productivity, to privilege the smallholder agriculture and complex, diverse and risk prone realities of majority of the farmers through enhancing farmers-scientists interface. There are concepts and domains that are new in emphasis like resource management, climate resilient agriculture, production management including storage, market, supply chains, value chains, innovation systems, information systems, etc.
text.mr: The Farmer FIRST Programme (FFP) is an ICAR initiative to move beyond the production and productivity, to privilege the smallholder agriculture and complex, diverse and risk prone realities of majority of the farmers through enhancing farmers-scientists interface. There are concepts and domains that are new in emphasis like resource management, climate resilient agriculture, production management including storage, market, supply chains, value chains, innovation systems, information systems, etc.

text.en: The Farmer FIRST as a concept of ICAR is developed as farmer in a centric role for research problem identification, prioritization and conduct of experiments and its management in farmers’ conditions. The focus is on farmer’s Farm, Innovations, Resources, Science and Technology (FIRST). Two terms ‘enriching knowledge’ and ‘integrating technology’ qualify the meaning of Farmer FIRST in Indian context. Enriching knowledge signifies the need for the research system as well as farmers to learn from each other in context to existing farm environment, perception of each other and interactions with the sub-systems established around. Technology integration is looked from the perspective that the scientific outputs coming out from the research institutions, many times do not fit as such in the farmers’ conditions and thus, certain alterations and adaptations are required at field level for their acceptance, adoption and success.

The focus is on farmer’s Farm, Innovations, Resources, Science and Technology (FIRST). Two terms ‘enriching knowledge’ and ‘integrating technology’ qualify the meaning of Farmer FIRST in Indian context. Enriching knowledge signifies the need for the research system as well as farmers to learn from each other in context to existing farm environment, perception of each other and interactions with the sub-systems established around. Technology integration is looked from the perspective that the scientific outputs coming out from the research institutions, many times do not fit as such in the farmers’ conditions and thus, certain alterations and adaptations are required at field level for their acceptance, adoption and success.

text.en: The project entitled “Socio-economic Empowerment of Farmers through Farming System Interventions for Sustainable Agriculture Development in Ahmednagar District” under ICAR Farmer FIRST Programme is being implemented by the university since 2016-17. The project focuses on the Integrated Farming System (IFS) modules and is being implemented in chinchvihire and Kangar Villages of Ahmednagar district. Around 750 farm families are involved in this programme. The various IFS components include pulses and cereals production technologies, horticultural crops along with dairy management, farm pond fishery, goatry and backyard poultry. This would lead to increasing crop productivity and income. This technology application approach need to be out scaled and up scaled for the benefit of both research and extension system.

text.en: MPKV has pioneered in rural development and extension of new agricultural technologies to the farmers since its establishment. Extension education is one of the important mandates of the university. The Directorate of Extension Education was started in the year 1981 for the planning and execution of programmes of extension work based on the results of research and work in cooperation with the other Directorates of the University.
text.mr: MPKV has pioneered in rural development and extension of new agricultural technologies to the farmers since its establishment. Extension education is one of the important mandates of the university. The Directorate of Extension Education was started in the year 1981 for the planning and execution of programmes of extension work based on the results of research and work in cooperation with the other Directorates of the University.

text.en: The Directorate of Extension Education supervises and controls all extension education activities of the University. The Directorate of Extension Education, in close consultation with the Government Development Departments and other allied departments is responsible to provide them with the improved research findings of the University and cause to publish extension bulletins, circulars, news article and press release which summarize important research findings of benefits to the farming community.

The Directorate of Extension Education, in close consultation with the Government Development Departments and other allied departments is responsible to provide them with the improved research findings of the University and cause to publish extension bulletins, circulars, news article and press release which summarize important research findings of benefits to the farming community.

text.en: The Directorate performs activities like co-ordination of extension education activities in the jurisdiction of University. The Directorate through its various units viz., Agricultural Technology Information Centers (01), Regional Extension Centers (04), District Extension Centers (05) and Krishi Vigyan Kendras (17) performs this pivotal activity by organizing on campus and off campus extension programmes viz., Training programmes, FLDs, Farmers Rallies, Field Visits, Diagnostic Team Visits, On Farm Trials, Exhibitions, Field days etc. for transfer of technologies and collecting feed back.

text.en:
The Agricultural Technology Information Center (ATIC) is single window delivery dissemination and supporting system for various innovative and farm worthy techniques evolved at the university and affiliated organization in the pursuit of research and excellence. This Center started its actual functioning w.e.f. 13th August, 2001 with the following objectives.To empower farmers through direct access to information and knowledge.To create strong linkage between different research divisions, units and user of technology.To help farmers in problem solving and decision making.To facilitate and dynamic feed forward and feed back mechanism.To bridge the gap between attainable and attained in the crop, livestock development and production.To generate financial resources through sales and services.To disseminate the new technologies developed by the University through organizing Farmers Rallies, Field Visits and
                            Agril. Exhibitions.
text.mr:
The Agricultural Technology Information Center (ATIC) is single window delivery dissemination and supporting system for various innovative and farm worthy techniques evolved at the university and affiliated organization in the pursuit of research and excellence.                             Agril. Exhibitions.

text.en: The ATIC is supervised by the Manager with four subject matter specialists (SMS) from the disciplines viz., Agronomy, Horticulture, Plant protection and Animal husbandry and Dairy and Public Relation Officer (PRO). The extension activities like field visits, replying the queries of the farmers and other stakeholders and the center performs diagnostic services in coordination with the other departments of University. Besides, the seed and seedlings, processed products and publications are also sold through ATIC to the end users.

text.en: A Communication Center was established in May 1982 with the financial assistance of the ICAR, New Delhi for five years. text.en: Regional Extension Centers established in the year 2002 to test and transfer the improved technology from time to time in adjoining areas of respective research and educational institutes. Three RECs are started at the constituent colleges, viz., Pune, Dhule and Kolhapur and one at Central Campus, MPKV, Rahuri. Regional Extension Center consists of four SMS in the subject of Agronomy, Animal Husbandary, Horticulture and Plant protection. The activities of each REC are governed by Extension Agronomist at regional level, which is technically controlled by Director of Extension Education.To organize short duration training classes for up-gradation of knowledge of existing staff.To arrange farmers trainings for solving the problems in farming.To interact with farmers and officers for getting feed back on research findings.To arrange monthly meetings of different allied departments and interact on various field problems.To integrate teaching, research and extension education activities.

The activities of each REC are governed by Extension Agronomist at regional level, which is technically controlled by Director of Extension Education.To organize short duration training classes for up-gradation of knowledge of existing staff.To arrange farmers trainings for solving the problems in farming.To interact with farmers and officers for getting feed back on research findings.To arrange monthly meetings of different allied departments and interact on various field problems.To integrate teaching, research and extension education activities.

text.en: The staff under the RECs usually undertakes activities relating to transfer of technology in the adjacent areas. The activities like, monthly district workshops, fortnightly trainings, demonstrations on farmers fields, farmers’ rallies and technical guidance to farmers are also organized by the Center.

The fix route of this activity is announced and communicated well in advance to the farmers of respective villages and accordingly the farmers avail the guidance and necessary help to solve their problems.

text.en: The faculty of Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth, Rahuri comprises over 800 accomplished professors, scientists, and agricultural specialists engaged across 10 constituent colleges, the Post Graduate Institute (PGI), and 27 research stations. The faculty is organized under major disciplines including Agronomy, Genetics & Plant Breeding, Soil Science, Horticulture, Entomology, Plant Pathology, Agricultural Engineering, and Extension Education.
text.mr: महात्मा फुले कृषि विद्यापीठ, राहुरी मध्ये १० घटक महाविद्यालये, पदव्युत्तर संस्था (PGI) आणि २७ संशोधन केंद्रांमध्ये ८०० हून अधिक प्राध्यापक, शास्त्रज्ञ व विषय विशेषज्ञ कार्यरत आहेत. कृषिविज्ञान, वनस्पती पैदास, मृदविज्ञान, उद्यानविद्या, कीटकशास्त्र, वनस्पती रोगशास्त्र, कृषि अभियांत्रिकी व विस्तार शिक्षण अशा प्रमुख शाखांमध्ये हे तज्ज्ञ अध्यापन व संशोधन करतात.

text.en: To facilitate global research collaboration and scientific transparency, detailed individual academic profiles, publications, h-index citations, and patents of all MPKV faculty members are cataloged on the official National IRINS (Indian Research Information Network System) Portal at mpkv.irins.org.
text.mr: संशोधनातील पारदर्शकता व जागतिक सहकार्यासाठी सर्व प्राध्यापकांची वैयक्तिक संशोधक प्रोफाइल, शोधनिबंध, h-index उद्धरणे आणि पेटंट्स राष्ट्रीय आयरिन्स (IRINS - Vidwan) प्रणालीवर mpkv.irins.org येथे ऑनलाइन उपलब्ध आहेत.

title.mr: किसान आधार संमेलन

subtitle.en: MPKV & Govt. of Maharashtra's flagship mega agri-expo since 2017 featuring 100-acre crop demonstrations, livestock expos, scientist dialogues, audio jingles & archived reports.
subtitle.mr: सन २०१७ पासून महात्मा फुले कृषि विद्यापीठ व महाराष्ट्र शासन आयोजित भव्य कृषि प्रदर्शन, १०० एकरवरील पीक प्रात्यक्षिके, पशुप्रदर्शन व चर्चासत्रे.

overview.mr: महात्मा फुले कृषि विद्यापीठ आणि कृषि विभाग, महाराष्ट्र शासन यांच्या संयुक्त विद्यमाने महात्मा फुले कृषि विद्यापीठ सन 2017 पासुन भव्य किसान आधार संमेलनाचे आयोजन करण्यात येत आहे. या किसान आधार संमेलनात शेतकर्‍यांसाठी कृषि प्रदर्शन, विविध पिकांचे प्रात्यक्षिके, पशु प्रदर्शन आणि विविध कृषि विषयांवर व्याख्याणे व चर्चासत्रांचे आयोजन करण्यात येत असते. तेलबिया, कडधान्य, तृणधान्य, भाजीपाला, चारा आणि नगदी पिकांमधील विविध वाणांचे प्रक्षेत्र प्रात्यक्षिके तसेच ड्रॅगन फ्रुट, शेडनेट शेती, सिंचन प्रणाली, माती परीक्षण, एकात्मिक शेती मॉडेल, गांडूळ खत, मधुमक्षिका पालन, जिवाणू खते व जैविक कीड नियंत्रण प्रात्यक्षिकांचा समावेश केला जातो.
overview.en: Jointly organized by MPKV Rahuri and the Department of Agriculture, Government of Maharashtra since 2017, Kisan Aadhar Sammelan brings together live crop demonstrations (oilseeds, pulses, cereals, vegetables, dragon fruit, shade-net floriculture), integrated farming models, micro-irrigation, vermicompost, apiculture, private agri-tech stalls, livestock expos, and scientist–farmer dialogues.

title.mr: किसान आधार संमेलन २०१९
title.en: Kisan Aadhar Sammelan 2019

summary.mr: दि. 25 ते 26 ऑक्टोबर, 2019 रोजी राहुरी येथे आयोजन. उद्घाटन राष्ट्रीय कोरडवाहू क्षेत्र प्राधिकरणाचे मुख्य कार्यकारी अधिकारी डॉ. अशोक दलवाई यांच्या हस्ते तर अध्यक्षस्थानी कुलगुरु डॉ. के. पी. विश्वनाथा होते. स्वागत व प्रास्ताविक डॉ. शरद गडाख यांनी केले.
summary.en: Held on 25–26 October 2019 at MPKV Rahuri. Inaugurated by Dr. Ashok Dalwai (CEO, NRAA, New Delhi) and chaired by Vice-Chancellor Dr. K. P. Viswanatha with dignitaries from MCAER, ATMA & Govt. Agriculture Dept.

title.mr: किसान आधार संमेलन २०१८
title.en: Kisan Aadhar Sammelan 2018

summary.mr: दि. 15 ते 18 ऑक्टोबर, 2018 दरम्यान आयोजन. उद्घाटन मंत्री ना. चंद्रकांत (दादा) पाटील यांच्या हस्ते व अध्यक्षस्थानी ना. प्रा. राम शिंदे होते. 100 एकर क्षेत्रावर 30 पिकांचे 101 वाण व 15 भाजीपाला पिकांचे 30 वाणांची प्रात्यक्षिके आयोजित केली होती.
summary.en: Held 15–18 October 2018. Inaugurated by Revenue & Agriculture Minister Hon. Chandrakant Patil. Featured 100-acre field demonstrations covering 101 varieties of 30 crops and 30 varieties of 15 vegetables.

title.mr: किसान आधार संमेलन २०१७
title.en: Kisan Aadhar Sammelan 2017

summary.mr: संकल्प से सिध्दी — उन्नत शेती समृध्द शेतकरी अंतर्गत दि. 25–29 सप्टेंबर, 2017 रोजी आयोजन. उद्घाटन कृषि मंत्री ना. पांडुरंग फुंदकर यांच्या हस्ते तर पशुप्रदर्शन उद्घाटन ना. महादेव जानकर यांच्या हस्ते झाले. 100 एकरवर 30 पिकांचे 101 वाण व 14 भाजीपाला पिकांचे 28 वाण दाखवले.
summary.en: Held 25–29 September 2017 under Sankalp Se Siddhi (Unnat Sheti – Samruddh Shetkari), inaugurated by Hon. Pandurang Fundkar. Showcased 101 varieties of 30 crops and 28 varieties of 14 vegetables over 100 acres.

title.mr: शेतकरी – शास्त्रज्ञ मंच

subtitle.en: Launched on 11 October 2005 across MPKV research stations, colleges & polytechnics — connecting 1,668 member farmers through 54 active grassroot forums.
subtitle.mr: ११ ऑक्टोबर २००५ पासून ५४ शेतकरी-शास्त्रज्ञ मंच आणि १,६६८ सभासद शेतकऱ्यांच्या समन्वयातून सुधारित कृषि तंत्रज्ञान प्रसार.

intro.mr: महात्मा फुले कृषि विद्यापीठाच्या संशोधन प्रक्रियेतून निर्माण झालेले सुधारित कृषि तंत्रज्ञान, शेतकरी आणि शास्त्रज्ञ यांच्या योग्य समन्वयातून प्रसारीत केले तर त्याचे अवलंबन शेतकरी स्तरावर मोठया प्रमाणावर होऊन कृषिविकासाला चालना मिळेल, याच संकल्पनेतून विस्तार कार्याला बळकटीकरण येण्यासाठी 11 ऑक्टोबर, 2005 पासून हाती घेतलेला आहे. महात्मा फुले कृषि विद्यापीठ अंतर्गत संशोधन केंद्रे, कृषि महाविद्यालये आणि कृषि तंत्र विद्यालये येथे एकुण 54 शेतकरी - शास्त्रज्ञ मंचाची स्थापना केली असून एकूण 1668 सभासद याचा लाभ घेत आहेत.
intro.en: Initiated on 11 October 2005 to strengthen technology transfer through direct scientist–farmer coordination. Across MPKV research stations, constituent agriculture colleges, and agricultural technology schools, 54 Farmer–Scientist Forums have been established serving 1,668 member farmers.

objectives.mr: कृषि विद्यापीठातील शास्त्रज्ञ अधिकारी शेतकरी यांच्यामध्ये समन्वय साधून त्यांना मार्गदर्शन करणे.
objectives.en: Coordinate between university scientists, officers and farmers for field guidance.

objectives.mr: शेतक-यांच्या आणि गावांच्या सर्वांगिण आर्थिक व सामाजिक विकासासाठी कृषि विद्यापीठामार्फत विविध योजना राबविणे.
objectives.en: Implement university extension schemes for holistic socio-economic development of farmers and villages.

objectives.mr: विद्यापीठाने विकसीत केलेले संशोधीत तंत्रज्ञानाचा वापर करणेकरिता शेतक-यांना प्रवृत्त करणे.
objectives.en: Motivate farmers to adopt improved technologies and varieties developed by the university.

objectives.mr: शेतीविषयक परिस्थितीनुसार शेतक-यांकडून आलेल्या प्रश्नांची त्वरीत दखल घेऊन त्यानुसार संशोधनाचे नियोजन करणे.
objectives.en: Respond promptly to field problems raised by farmers and align research planning accordingly.

objectives.mr: मंचातील सभासदांच्या शेतीचा एक आदर्श निर्माण करणे त्याचे अनुकरण इतर शेतक-यांनी करणे बाबत प्रोत्साहन देणे.
objectives.en: Establish model demonstration farms of forum members to encourage peer adoption.

functions.mr: शेतकरी-शास्त्रज्ञ मंचाची महिन्यातून एकदा बैठक आयोजित करणे आणि हंगामनिहाय शेतक-यांचे प्रश्न सोडविणे.
functions.en: Conduct monthly forum meetings to resolve season-wise agricultural issues.

functions.mr: विद्यापीठामार्फत घेण्यात येणा-या सर्व प्रात्यक्षिका मध्ये मंचाच्या सभासदाला प्राधान्य देणे.
functions.en: Provide priority to forum members across all university field demonstrations.

functions.mr: मंचातील सभासद शेतक-यांची संपूर्ण माहिती प्रश्नावलीत भरुन तिचे विश्लेषण करुन मार्गदर्शन करणे.
functions.en: Collect, analyze and advise on detailed member farmer farm profiles.

functions.mr: मंचातील प्रत्येक सभासदाच्या जमिनीची आरोग्यपत्रिका तयार करुन पीक पध्दती आणि खत मात्रा सुचविणे.
functions.en: Prepare Soil Health Cards for each member and recommend cropping patterns & fertilizer doses.

functions.mr: पिकांचे फिरते चिकित्सालय तज्ञ पथकासह मंचातील सभासदांच्या गावांना प्राधान्य देणे.
functions.en: Prioritize member villages for Mobile Crop Clinics led by specialist teams.

functions.mr: कृषि विद्यापीठातील आयोजित करण्यात येणा-या सर्व चर्चासत्रे / कृषि प्रदर्शने / मेळावे / प्रशिक्षण / शिवार फेरीमध्ये मंचातील सभासदांना निमंत्रित करणे.
functions.en: Invite members to university seminars, agri expos, trainings & Shivar Pheri field days.

functions.mr: उत्पादित शेतमालाकरिता योग्य त्या बाजारपेठेची माहिती तसेच काढणीपश्चात तंत्रज्ञानाबद्दल सभासदांना माहिती देणे.
functions.en: Provide market intelligence and post-harvest technology guidance to members.

desc.en: Hold and manage the property and investments of the University and advise the University as regards its financial policy.
desc.mr: विद्यापीठाची स्थावर-जंगम मालमत्ता व गुंतवणुकीचे कायदेशीर व्यवस्थापन करणे व विद्यापीठाला सर्वसमावेशक वित्तीय सल्ला देणे.

title.mr: अंदाजपत्रकीय नियंत्रण व खर्च संमती

desc.en: Ensure that no expenditure not authorized in the budget is incurred by the University, and ensure that expenditures are strictly made as authorized in the budget.
desc.mr: अंदाजपत्रकात मान्यता नसलेला कोणताही खर्च विद्यापीठाकडून होणार नाही याची दक्षता घेणे व मंजूर तरतुदींनुसारच खर्च करणे.

title.en: Statutory Expenditure Disallowance

desc.mr: अधिनियम अथवा परिनियमांचे उल्लंघन करणारा कोणताही खर्च नामंजूर (Disallow) करण्याचे पूर्ण वैधानिक अधिकार.

title.en: Executive Council Irregularity Reporting
title.mr: कार्यकारी परिषदेस वित्तीय अनियमितता अहवाल

desc.mr: अनधिकृत खर्च किंवा वित्तीय गैरव्यवहारांबाबत संबंधित व्यक्तींकडून स्पष्टीकरण मागवून त्यांच्यावर शिस्तभंगाची कारवाई करण्याची शिफारस कार्यकारी परिषदेला करणे.

title.mr: अधिदान व प्रदान सर्वोच्च अधिकारी

desc.en: Act as Pay and receiving officer. Receive all moneys due to or receivable on behalf of the University, bring them forthwith to Accounts, and settle all claims preferred against the University.
desc.mr: विद्यापीठास मिळणाऱ्या सर्व रकमा तात्काळ जमा खाती घेणे व विद्यापीठाविरुद्धचे सर्व वैध दावे व देयके नियमानुसार अदा करणे.

title.en: Rules Compliance & MCAER Consultation
title.mr: लेखा संहिता व एमसीएईआर समन्वय

desc.en: Complete the accounts of the University in accordance with the prescribed rules, and seek Government advice through MCAER with the approval of the Vice-Chancellor on any doubtful financial rules.
desc.mr: लेखा संहितेनुसार विद्यापीठाचे वार्षिक ताळेबंद पूर्ण करणे व कायदेशीर साशंकतेबाबत कुलगुरूंच्या मान्यतेने एमसीएईआरमार्फत शासनाचा सल्ला घेणे.

title.en: Financial Powers Delegation Concurrence
title.mr: वित्तीय अधिकार प्रदानास अनिवार्य संमती

desc.en: All financial powers delegated to various university authorities to run various activities shall be delegated only with the concurrence of the Comptroller.
desc.mr: विद्यापीठाच्या कोणत्याही अधिकाऱ्यास किंवा प्राधिकरणास वित्तीय अधिकार प्रदान करताना नियंत्रकांची पूर्वसंमती अनिवार्य असते.

title.en: Internal Auditor of the University
title.mr: अंतर्गत लेखापरीक्षण (Internal Audit)

desc.en: Function as the Internal Auditor of the Vidyapeeth and ensure all orders involving financial implications are issued only after his concurrence.
desc.mr: विद्यापीठाचे मुख्य अंतर्गत लेखापरीक्षक म्हणून काम पाहणे व वित्तीय परिणाम असणाऱ्या सर्व प्रशासकीय आदेशांना पूर्वमान्यता देणे.

title.mr: निवृत्तीवेतन लाभ वाटप

desc.en: Timely disbursement of pension, gratuity, commutation, and family pensionary benefits to retired academic and administrative personnel.
desc.mr: विद्यापीठातील सेवानिवृत्त प्राध्यापक, शास्त्रज्ञ व कर्मचाऱ्यांना वेळेवर निवृत्तीवेतन, उपदान व इतर लाभांचे वितरण.

desc.mr: शासकीय, आयसीएआर व इतर अनुदाने, भविष्य निर्वाह निधी (GPF), राष्ट्रीय पेन्शन योजना (NPS) व फिरता निधीचे चोख हिशोब ठेवणे.

scope.mr: विद्यापीठ वार्षिक अंदाजपत्रक, एफएमजी अनुदाने, योजना व योजनेतर निधी वाटप.

title.en: Assistant Comptroller - 3
title.mr: सहाय्यक नियंत्रक ३

scope.en: Pension verification, gratuity claims, family pensions, and retirement entitlement disbursals.
scope.mr: निवृत्तीवेतन पडताळणी, उपदान दावे, कुटुंब निवृत्तीवेतन व सेवानिवृत्ती लाभ मंजुरी.

text.en: The Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth (MPKV), Rahuri is the premier Agricultural University in Maharashtra that renders services to the farmers through Education, Research and Extension Education. In pursuance of the Maharashtra Agricultural University (Krishi Vidyapeeth) Act 1967, initially, the Maharashtra Agricultural University (Krishi Vidyapeeth) was established for the entire Maharashtra State and started functioning in March, 1968 with its office at Mumbai.
text.mr: The Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth (MPKV), Rahuri is the premier Agricultural University in Maharashtra that renders services to the farmers through Education, Research and Extension Education. In pursuance of the Maharashtra Agricultural University (Krishi Vidyapeeth) Act 1967, initially, the Maharashtra Agricultural University (Krishi Vidyapeeth) was established for the entire Maharashtra State and started functioning in March, 1968 with its office at Mumbai.

text.en: The office was shifted to College of Agriculture, Pune in 1969. Later on in 1972, four agricultural universities were established in Maharashtra. Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth, Rahuri is one of them established in 1969 for the western Maharashtra having jurisdiction spread over 10 districts viz. Jalgaon, Nandurbar, Dhule, Nashik, Ahmednagar,Pune, Solapur, Satara, Sangli and Kolhapur. The University is named after the great social reformer "Mahatma Jyotiba Phule".

text.en: The Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth (MPKV), Rahuri is the premier Agricultural University in Maharashtra that renders services to the farmers through Education, Research and Extension Education. In pursuance of the Maharashtra Agricultural University (Krishi Vidyapeeth) Act 1967, initially, the Maharashtra Agricultural University (Krishi Vidyapeeth) was established for the entire Maharashtra State and started functioning in March, 1968 with its office at Mumbai.
text.mr: The Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth (MPKV), Rahuri is the premier Agricultural University in Maharashtra that renders services to the farmers through Education, Research and Extension Education. In pursuance of the Maharashtra Agricultural University (Krishi Vidyapeeth) Act 1967, initially, the Maharashtra Agricultural University (Krishi Vidyapeeth) was established for the entire Maharashtra State and started functioning in March, 1968 with its office at Mumbai.

text.en: The office was shifted to College of Agriculture, Pune in 1969. Later on in 1972, four agricultural universities were established in Maharashtra. Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth, Rahuri is one of them established in 1969 for the western Maharashtra having jurisdiction spread over 10 districts viz. Jalgaon, Nandurbar, Dhule, Nashik, Ahmednagar,Pune, Solapur, Satara, Sangli and Kolhapur. The University is named after the great social reformer "Mahatma Jyotiba Phule".

introduction.formulationEn: The Internal Quality Assurance Cell (IQAC) was formulated at Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth, Rahuri in March, 2014. As per directives of MCAER, Pune, the Internal Quality Assurance Cell was revised as the Internal Quality Assessment Cell and its composition was updated.
introduction.formulationMr: महात्मा फुले कृषी विद्यापीठ, राहुरी येथे मार्च २०१४ मध्ये अंतर्गत गुणवत्ता हमी कक्षाची (IQAC) स्थापना करण्यात आली. महाराष्ट्र कृषी शिक्षण व संशोधन परिषद (MCAER), पुणे यांच्या निर्देशांनुसार या कक्षाची 'अंतर्गत गुणवत्ता मूल्यांकन कक्ष' म्हणून पुनर्रचना करून समितीची रचना निश्चित करण्यात आली आहे.
introduction.mandateEn: The IQAC acts as the documentation and record-keeping cell for the institution, including assistance in the development of the API (Academic Performance Indicator) criteria as per PBAS (Performance Based Appraisal System) proforma using the indicative template separately developed according to UGC Rules and Regulations common to all teaching and research staff members in the jurisdiction of the University. The IQAC scrutinizes all cases of promotion through the Career Advancement Scheme (CAS) and scrutinizes applications submitted by University Officers for various posts outside the University as per requirement.
introduction.mandateMr: IQAC कक्ष विद्यापीठाचे अधिकृत दस्तऐवजीकरण व अभिलेख संकलन केंद्र म्हणून कार्य करते. विद्यापीठ कार्यक्षेत्रातील सर्व शिक्षक व संशोधन कर्मचाऱ्यांसाठी UGC नियम व नियमावलीनुसार PBAS (Performance Based Appraisal System) अंतर्गत API (Academic Performance Indicator) निकष व विहित नमुने विकसित करण्यास कक्ष सहाय्य करते. तसेच करिअर ॲडव्हान्समेंट स्कीम (CAS) अंतर्गत सर्व पदोन्नती प्रस्तावांची आणि विद्यापीठ अधिकाऱ्यांनी विद्यापीठाबाहेरील पदांसाठी केलेल्या अर्जांची छाननी IQAC मार्फत केली जाते.

functions.descEn: Develops Academic Performance Indicator (API) criteria and PBAS indicative proforma per UGC Rules common to all teaching and research staff.
functions.descMr: सर्व शिक्षक व संशोधक कर्मचाऱ्यांसाठी UGC नियमांनुसार PBAS आधारित API मूल्यमापन निकष व नमुने विकसित करणे.

functions.descEn: Scrutinizes all faculty and scientist promotion dossiers submitted under the Career Advancement Scheme across MPKV jurisdiction.
functions.descMr: विद्यापीठ कार्यक्षेत्रातील प्राध्यापक व शास्त्रज्ञांच्या CAS पदोन्नती प्रकरणांची सखोल व काटेकोर छाननी करणे.

functions.descEn: Verifies and scrutinizes applications submitted by University Officers for prestigious appointments outside the University.
functions.descMr: विद्यापीठ अधिकाऱ्यांनी विद्यापीठाबाहेरील पदांसाठी सादर केलेल्या अर्जांची नियमांनुसार छाननी व पडताळणी करणे.

body.en: Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth is one of the best universities among Maharashtra with a mandate of agricultural education, research and extension. Libraries play pivotal role in dissemination of knowledge and information to the students, readers in their education, research and extension activities. In order to cater the needs of the readers, the University Library, started functioning at Central Campus in the year 1968 with a merge collection of 2070 books only. It is developing steadily under the able guidance of Vice-Chancellor and Chairmanship of Library Advisory Committee and rendering various services to the readers, scientists, teachers, students etc. since last fifty years.
body.mr: महात्मा फुले कृषि विद्यापीठ हे कृषी शिक्षण, संशोधन आणि विस्तार कार्य करणारे महाराष्ट्रातील एक अग्रगण्य विद्यापीठ आहे. विद्यार्थी व वाचकांच्या शिक्षण, संशोधन आणि विस्तार कार्यात ज्ञान व माहितीचा प्रसार करण्यात ग्रंथालय महत्त्वाची भूमिका बजावते. वाचकांच्या गरजा पूर्ण करण्यासाठी विद्यापीठ ग्रंथालय १९६८ मध्ये मुख्य संकुलात केवळ २,०७० पुस्तकांच्या संग्रहासह सुरू झाले. कुलगुरूंच्या सक्षम मार्गदर्शनाखाली आणि ग्रंथालय सल्लागार समितीच्या अध्यक्षतेखाली ते सातत्याने विकसित होत असून गेल्या पन्नास वर्षांहून अधिक काळ वाचक, शास्त्रज्ञ, शिक्षक आणि विद्यार्थ्यांना विविध सेवा देत आहे.

body.en: Due to huge collection of books and documents, a beautiful and impressive separate building was constructed in 1980 with 3740 sq.mt. Carpet area. The library was shifted in the newly constructed building in December, 1980. The building is having length of 117 ft and the width of 130 ft. Extension of University Library building completed from the 100 crores grants received by ICAR in 2012. Two Sections viz: Reference Section & Theses Section shifted in new extended building by which sitting capacity of 150 readers increased. The University Library is kept open for usages from 9.00 to 21.00 hrs throughout the years except Sundays and Holidays. The University Library has also provided Reading Room Facility to the students, which is kept open from 9.00 to 23.00 hrs.
body.mr: पुस्तके आणि दस्तऐवजांच्या मोठ्या संग्रहामुळे १९८० मध्ये ३,७४० चौ.मी. कार्पेट क्षेत्रफळाची भव्य आणि स्वतंत्र इमारत बांधण्यात आली. डिसेंबर १९८० मध्ये ग्रंथालय नवीन इमारतीत स्थलांतरित केले गेले. इमारतीची लांबी ११७ फूट आणि रुंदी १३० फूट आहे. २०१२ मध्ये ICAR कडून प्राप्त झालेल्या ₹१०० कोटी अनुदानातून ग्रंथालय इमारतीचा विस्तार पूर्ण झाला. नवीन विस्तारित इमारतीत संदर्भ विभाग (Reference Section) व प्रबंध विभाग (Theses Section) स्थलांतरित करण्यात आले, ज्यामुळे १५० वाचकांची आसनक्षमता वाढली. रविवार आणि सुट्ट्या वगळता विद्यापीठ ग्रंथालय वर्षभर सकाळी ९.०० ते रात्री २१.०० वाजेपर्यंत खुले असते. विद्यार्थ्यांसाठी अभ्यासिका सुविधा (Reading Room Facility) सकाळी ९.०० ते रात्री २३.०० वाजेपर्यंत सुरू असते.

rules.en: The member is issued certain number of Borrower's Ticket (BT) for borrowing books. The BTs are NOT TRANSFERABLE and member is responsible for any loss of book issued against his BT. On loss of BT, member shall have to pay a fine of Rs. 10/- per BT.
rules.mr: सदस्यांना पुस्तक घेण्यासाठी ठराविक बॉरोअर्स तिकीट (BT) दिले जातात. ही तिकिटे हस्तांतरणीय नाहीत; तिकीट हरवल्यास प्रति BT ₹१०/- दंड आकारला जाईल.

rules.en: If the book issued to the member is not returned on or before the due date, a late fee of Rs. 1/- per day per book is charged. In case a book issued for overnight is not returned next day, a late fee of Rs. 2/- is charged per day per book.
rules.mr: मुदतीच्या आत पुस्तक परत न केल्यास प्रतिदिन प्रतिपुस्तक ₹१/- विलंब शुल्क आकारले जाईल. रात्रीपुरत्या (Overnight) पुस्तकास विलंब झाल्यास प्रतिदिन ₹२/- शुल्क लागू राहील.

rules.en: Member should not mark, underline or highlight words or sentences in the book by pencil or ink.
rules.mr: वाचकांनी पुस्तकात पेन्सिल किंवा शाईने खुणा करू नयेत अथवा अधोरेखित करू नये.

rules.en: The member is responsible for any damage caused to the book during the period it remains with them.
rules.mr: पुस्तक ताब्यात असताना झालेल्या कोणत्याही नुकसानीस संबंधित वाचक जबाबदार राहील.

rules.en: Borrower shall examine the condition of book before getting it issued in their name. The last borrower will be held responsible for any damage to the book.
rules.mr: पुस्तक नावावर घेण्यापूर्वी त्याची स्थिती तपासून घ्यावी; नुकसान आढळल्यास शेवटच्या वाचकास जबाबदार धरले जाईल.

rules.en: Do not pull the book from the shelf by holding its back cover. First push back two or three adjacent books and hold firmly at the middle of the spine to pull lightly.
rules.mr: कपाटातून पुस्तक काढताना मागच्या कव्हरला धरून ओढू नये; शेजारची पुस्तके मागे सरकवून मणक्याच्या मध्यभागातून हळुवार बाहेर काढावे.

rules.en: The book can be renewed for further period if it is not required by any other reader. Membership is open to bonafide students, faculty members and ministerial staff.
rules.mr: इतर कोणाची मागणी नसल्यास पुस्तकाचे नूतनीकरण (Renewal) करता येईल.

title.mr: ग्रंथ विभाग

description.en: There are 74,004 books in the collection. Books are classified and catalogued according to Dewey decimal classification and AACR Rule-II. List of subject Headings is also used in classification as supporting tool.
description.mr: या विभागात ७४,००४ पुस्तके आहेत. सर्व पुस्तकांचे वर्गीकरण ड्युई डेसिमल क्लासिफिकेशन (DDC) आणि कॅटलॉगिंग AACR नियम-II नुसार केले जाते.

title.en: Current Periodical Section
title.mr: चालू नियतकालिक विभाग

description.en: Library is receiving 75 research journals on agriculture. All periodicals are arranged alphabetically of which list is displayed for the use of readers.

title.en: Back Volume Section
title.mr: मागील नियतकालिक खंड विभाग

description.en: All back volumes of journals are arranged in alphabetical order in this section. At present the library is having 27,660 back volumes in its collection. The catalogues are published from time to time. Online version of catalogue is also made available through web.
description.mr: जुन्या संशोधन नियतकालिकांचे २७,६६० खंड येथे वर्णक्रमानुसार उपलब्ध आहेत. यांची सूची ऑनलाइन व मुद्रित स्वरूपात उपलब्ध आहे.

title.en: Theses Section
title.mr: प्रबंध विभाग

description.en: At present the library is having 8,681 theses in its collection. Department wise subject arrangement is maintained in this section. Catalogue of theses available is published from time to time for information of the users.
description.mr: येथे ८,६८१ पदव्युत्तर व पीएच.डी. प्रबंध विभागवार विषयानुसार संगतवार ठेवलेले आहेत.

title.en: Reference Section
title.mr: संदर्भ विभाग

description.en: Various types of reference documents such as Encyclopedias, Handbooks, Yearbooks, Dictionaries, Directories, Maps, Atlases etc. are made available through this section. These documents are accessible on library premises only. Special seating arrangement for SRF/ARS/ASRB/NET examinations is made in this section.
description.mr: विश्वकोश, हस्तपुस्तिका, शब्दकोश, नकाशे, ॲटलास इ. संदर्भ साहित्य येथे उपलब्ध आहे. SRF/ARS/ASRB/NET स्पर्धा परीक्षांसाठी येथे विशेष आसन व्यवस्था करण्यात आली आहे.

title.en: E-Granth Project (NAIP Component-1, ICAR NARS)
title.mr: ई-ग्रंथ प्रकल्प (ICAR NAIP घटक-१ अंतर्गत NARS)

summary.en: 'Strengthening of Digital Library and Information Management under NARS (e-GRANTH)' is a subproject under component-1 of National Agricultural Innovation Project (NAIP), Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR). National Agricultural Research System (NARS) in India comprises of Agricultural Research Institutions and Agricultural Universities. It provides digital access to library resources of 12 different research institutes and agricultural universities which include OPAC, important institutional repositories, rare books and old journals and makes them publicly accessible over internet under NARS with Online Computer Library Center (OCLC) partnership.
summary.mr: ICAR च्या राष्ट्रीय कृषी नवोपक्रम प्रकल्पांतर्गत (NAIP) 'e-GRANTH' हा उपप्रकल्प असून देशातील १२ प्रमुख कृषी संशोधन संस्था आणि कृषी विद्यापीठांच्या ग्रंथालय साधनांना OCLC भागीदारीतून डिजिटल व खुल्या स्वरूपात उपलब्ध करून देतो.

objectives.en: To create Online Public Access Catalog (OPAC) under Indian Agricultural Research Group Catalogue of all 12 library resources with Online Computer Library Center (OCLC) partnership.
objectives.mr: OCLC भागीदारीसह १२ ग्रंथालयांचा एकत्रित भारतीय कृषी संशोधन समूह तालिका (OPAC) तयार करणे.

objectives.en: To digitize important institutional repositories (limited to IARI New Delhi; IVRI Izatnagar; ANGRAU Hyderabad; and UAS Bangalore) including rare books and old journals and make them open access under NARS.
objectives.mr: दुर्मिळ पुस्तके, जुनी नियतकालिके आणि संस्थात्मक प्रबंधसंग्रहांचे डिजिटायझेशन करून NARS अंतर्गत खुले करणे.

objectives.en: To strengthen capacity building for library and information management system (open to all libraries of NARS).
objectives.mr: सर्व NARS ग्रंथालयांसाठी ग्रंथालय व माहिती व्यवस्थापन प्रणाली क्षमता बांधणी मजबूत करणे.

objectives.en: Implementation of KOHA (Open Source Software) for all the centers.
objectives.mr: सर्व केंद्रांवर KOHA ओपन-सोर्स ग्रंथालय सॉफ्टवेअर कार्यान्वित करणे.

text.en: Before the period of independence and during few years after independence, the non-agricultural universities were entrusted with the responsibility of agricultural education and the State Department of Agriculture contributed to research and extension. The agricultural universities were established in this country from 1960 according to the recommendations of Radhakrishnan Commission (1948).
text.mr: Before the period of independence and during few years after independence, the non-agricultural universities were entrusted with the responsibility of agricultural education and the State Department of Agriculture contributed to research and extension. The agricultural universities were established in this country from 1960 according to the recommendations of Radhakrishnan Commission (1948).

text.en: In pursuance of the Maharashtra Agricultural University (Krishi Vidyapeeth) Act 1967, initially, the Maharashtra Agricultural University (Krishi Vidyapeeth) was established for the entire Maharashtra State and started functioning from 29 March, 1968 with its office at Mumbai. The office was shifted to College of Agriculture, Pune in the year 1969. Subsequently in the same year, two agricultural universities and in 1972, two more agricultural universities were established. Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth (MPKV), Rahuri is one of them which was established in 1969 for the Western Maharashtra with its jurisdiction spread over ten districts namely, Satara, Sangli, Kolhapur, Ahmednagar, Solapur, Pune, Nashik, Dhule, Jalgaon and Nandurbar. The University is named after the great social reformer Mahatma Jyotiba Phule. The Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth, Rahuri is the premier Agricultural University in Maharashtra that renders services to the farmers through Education, Research and Extension Education.
text.mr: In pursuance of the Maharashtra Agricultural University (Krishi Vidyapeeth) Act 1967, initially, the Maharashtra Agricultural University (Krishi Vidyapeeth) was established for the entire Maharashtra State and started functioning from 29 March, 1968 with its office at Mumbai. The office was shifted to College of Agriculture, Pune in the year 1969. Subsequently in the same year, two agricultural universities and in 1972, two more agricultural universities were established. Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth (MPKV), Rahuri is one of them which was established in 1969 for the Western Maharashtra with its jurisdiction spread over ten districts namely, Satara, Sangli, Kolhapur, Ahmednagar, Solapur, Pune, Nashik, Dhule, Jalgaon and Nandurbar. The University is named after the great social reformer Mahatma Jyotiba Phule. The Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth, Rahuri is the premier Agricultural University in Maharashtra that renders services to the farmers through Education, Research and Extension Education.

text.en: The Governor of Maharashtra state is the Chancellor of the University, The Minister of Agriculture, Maharashtra state is the Pro-Chancellor, while, Vice-Chancellor is the Head of the University. The Executive Council is the highest policy making body of the University. The Vice-Chancellor is the Chairman of this Council. The Council constitutes of nominated peoples representatives, eminent members from agriculture and development departments, scientists, representative of ICAR and progressive farmers. The University is assisted by Academic Council, Agricultural Research Council, Extension Education Council for co-ordination and review of academic, research and extension education programmes, seed production and agricultural development programmes.
text.mr: The Governor of Maharashtra state is the Chancellor of the University, The Minister of Agriculture, Maharashtra state is the Pro-Chancellor, while, Vice-Chancellor is the Head of the University. The Executive Council is the highest policy making body of the University. The Vice-Chancellor is the Chairman of this Council. The Council constitutes of nominated peoples representatives, eminent members from agriculture and development departments, scientists, representative of ICAR and progressive farmers. The University is assisted by Academic Council, Agricultural Research Council, Extension Education Council for co-ordination and review of academic, research and extension education programmes, seed production and agricultural development programmes.

text.en: Before the period of independence and during few years after independence, the non-agricultural universities were entrusted with the responsibility of agricultural education and the State Department of Agriculture contributed to research and extension. The agricultural universities were established in this country from 1960 according to the recommendations of Radhakrishnan Commission (1948).
text.mr: Before the period of independence and during few years after independence, the non-agricultural universities were entrusted with the responsibility of agricultural education and the State Department of Agriculture contributed to research and extension. The agricultural universities were established in this country from 1960 according to the recommendations of Radhakrishnan Commission (1948).

text.en: In pursuance of the Maharashtra Agricultural University (Krishi Vidyapeeth) Act 1967, initially, the Maharashtra Agricultural University (Krishi Vidyapeeth) was established for the entire Maharashtra State and started functioning from 29 March, 1968 with its office at Mumbai. The office was shifted to College of Agriculture, Pune in the year 1969. Subsequently in the same year, two agricultural universities and in 1972, two more agricultural universities were established. Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth (MPKV), Rahuri is one of them which was established in 1969 for the Western Maharashtra with its jurisdiction spread over ten districts namely, Satara, Sangli, Kolhapur, Ahmednagar, Solapur, Pune, Nashik, Dhule, Jalgaon and Nandurbar. The University is named after the great social reformer Mahatma Jyotiba Phule. The Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth, Rahuri is the premier Agricultural University in Maharashtra that renders services to the farmers through Education, Research and Extension Education.

title.en: Planning, Monitoring & Evaluation (PME) Cell
title.mr: नियोजन, संनियंत्रण व मूल्यमापन कक्ष (PME Cell)

subtitle.en: Functioning since May 2018 at MPKV Rahuri to plan and monitor university development schemes, process infrastructure & research proposals with Government of Maharashtra & MCAER, and scrutinize scientist awards, trainings, and conference proposals.
subtitle.mr: मे २०१८ पासून कार्यरत PME कक्ष विद्यापीठाच्या विकास योजनांचे नियोजन व संनियंत्रण, महाराष्ट्र शासन व MCAER कडे संशोधन व पायाभूत सुविधा प्रस्ताव पाठविणे आणि शास्त्रज्ञांच्या पुरस्कार, प्रशिक्षण व परिषद प्रस्तावांची छाननी करण्याचे कार्य करते.

badge.en: Functioning Since May 2018 • State & Research Planning Cell
badge.mr: स्थापना मे २०१८ • विद्यापीठ नियोजन व मूल्यमापन कक्ष

introduction.historyEn: The Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation (PME) Cell has been functioning since May 2018. The major focus of the PME Cell is to plan and monitor various development programmes and activities of Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth. It acts as a coordination unit between the University and Government Departments of Maharashtra State, processing new research scheme proposals to secure funds for infrastructure development and facilitating schemes for the farming community.
introduction.historyMr: नियोजन, संनियंत्रण व मूल्यमापन कक्ष (PME Cell) मे २०१८ पासून कार्यरत आहे. महात्मा फुले कृषी विद्यापीठाच्या विविध विकास कार्यक्रमांचे आणि उपक्रमांचे नियोजन व संनियंत्रण करणे हा या कक्षाचा मुख्य उद्देश आहे. हा कक्ष विद्यापीठ आणि महाराष्ट्र शासनाचे विविध विभाग यांच्यातील समन्वय दुवा म्हणून कार्य करतो, तसेच पायाभूत सुविधा विकासासाठी नवीन संशोधन योजनांचे प्रस्ताव तयार करून निधी उपलब्ध करून देतो.
introduction.mandateEn: The Cell is actively involved in scrutinizing award, training, conference, workshop, and seminar proposals of university scientists and faculty for onward submission. It has developed standardized formats for project proposals, research publications, books, awards, and popular articles, while preparing the University Vision Document, infrastructure plan, and student database. The PME Cell office is located in the Administration Building near the Office of the Directorate of Research.
introduction.mandateMr: विद्यापीठातील शास्त्रज्ञ व प्राध्यापकांचे पुरस्कार, प्रशिक्षण, राष्ट्रीय-आंतरराष्ट्रीय परिषद व कार्यशाळा प्रस्ताव छाननी करून पुढील मंजुरीसाठी सादर करण्याची जबाबदारी PME कक्ष पार पाडतो. या कक्षाने प्रकल्प प्रस्ताव, संशोधन प्रकाशने, पुस्तके व लोकप्रिय लेखांसाठी विहित नमुने विकसित केले असून विद्यापीठाचे व्हिजन डॉक्युमेंट व पायाभूत सुविधा आराखडा तयार करण्याचे काम सुरू आहे. PME कक्षाचे कार्यालय मध्यवर्ती प्रशासकीय इमारतीत संशोधन संचालक कार्यालयाजवळ स्थित आहे.

pillars.descEn: Acts as official liaison between MPKV Rahuri, MCAER Pune, and Maharashtra State Government Departments for new development & research schemes.
pillars.descMr: नवीन संशोधन व विकास योजनांच्या मंजुरीसाठी विद्यापीठ, MCAER पुणे आणि महाराष्ट्र शासन यांच्यात अधिकृत समन्वय.

pillars.descEn: Processes new research scheme proposals for infrastructure funding, prepares University Vision Document & long-term capital plans.
pillars.descMr: पायाभूत सुविधा निधीसाठी नवीन संशोधन प्रस्ताव प्रक्रिया, विद्यापीठ व्हिजन डॉक्युमेंट व विकास आराखडा निर्मिती.

pillars.descEn: Scrutinizes faculty/scientist proposals for national/international trainings, awards, conferences, seminars, workshops & publications.
pillars.descMr: शास्त्रज्ञ व प्राध्यापकांच्या पुरस्कार, प्रशिक्षण, परिषद, कार्यशाळा व प्रकाशन प्रस्तावांची तांत्रिक छाननी व मार्गदर्शक तत्त्वे.

pillars.descEn: Monitors execution quality across Research, Education, and Extension Education wings and maintains ongoing ad-hoc project & staff databases.
pillars.descMr: संशोधन, शिक्षण व विस्तार शिक्षण उपक्रमांचे गुणवत्ता संनियंत्रण तसेच प्रकल्प व मनुष्यबळ माहिती संकलन.

text.mr: Dr A.S. College of Agril. Engg. & Tech., Rahuri

text.en: The university has a very good network of 27 research stations spread over 5 different agro-climatic zones having 82 non-plan schemes funded by State Govt., 45 AICRPs on different crops /plant sciences and one Centrally Sponsored Research Schemes funded by the Central Govt., Ministry of Agriculture, where varietal development and technology verification of more than 100 crops (cereals, pulses, oilseeds, vegetable , cash crops protected cultivation , exotic vegetables and fruit crops) is being carried out. In addition to this management of natural resource management, development of integrated farming system model research is undertaken for the upliftment of resource poor farming community.
text.mr: पश्चिम महाराष्ट्रातील दहा जिल्हयांचा समावेश असलेले घाट विभाग, उप-पर्वतीय विभाग, मैदानी विभाग, अवर्षण प्रवण विभाग व मध्य महाराष्ट्रातील पठारी विभाग या 5 हवामान विभागात असलेली तृणधान्‍ये, कडधान्‍ये, गळीताची धान्‍ये, फळे-भाजीपाला, नगदी पिके, विदेशी भाजीपाला इत्‍यादी १०० हून अधिक पिकावर, मध्यवर्ती परिसरासह एकूण 27 संशोधन केंद्रावर असलेल्‍या राज्य शासन अनुदानित 82 योजनेतर योजना, भारतीय कृषि संशोधन परिषद (75 %) आणि राज्य शासन (25 %) अनुदानीत 45 अखिल भारतीय समन्वीत संशोधन प्रकल्प आणि केंद्र पुरस्कृत 100 टक्के अनुदानीत 1 संशोधन प्रकल्पामार्फत संशोधन केले जाते.

text.en: To improve production and productivity of cereals, pulses, oilseeds, sugarcane, cotton, fruits, vegetables, flowers and farm animals. To conserve natural resources and improve their efficiency for sustainable production of crops and animal produce. Conservation of genetic resource and their maintenance.
text.mr: राज्यातील मर्यादित सिंचन सुविधा लक्षात घेऊन, शाश्‍वत उत्‍पादनासाठी कोरडवाहू शेती तंत्रज्ञान विकसित करणे. मृद आणि जलसंधारणाच्या पध्दती, जमीन, पाऊसमान आणि हंगामानुसार पीक व्यवस्थापन, मध्य हंगाम दुरुस्ती, पडणाऱ्या पाऊस पाण्याचा अधिक कार्यक्षमतेने वापर, पिकांचे सुधारित वाण आणि पीक पध्दती विकसित करणे, शेतक-यांच्या गरजा लक्षात घेऊन विविध प्रकारची शेती औजारे व यंत्रे विकसीत करणे याविषयी बहुमोल संशोधनवर भर देण्‍यात येत आहे. गेल्या 53 वर्षात कृषि क्षेत्रात भरीव संशोधन करुन एकूण 270 वाण विकसीत केलेले आहेत. मृद व जलसंधारण, विविध पिके आणि पीक लागवड पध्दती, अन्नद्रव्य व्यवस्थापन, पाणी व्यवस्थापन, आंतरमशागत, तण, रोग आणि किडींचे एकात्मिक व्यवस्थापन, नियंत्रीत शेती, प्रक्रिया आणि विपणन  याविषयी सखोल संशोधन करुन विद्यापीठाने एकूण 1577 शिफारशी दिल्या आहेत. जैवतंत्रज्ञान, वनस्पती ऊती संवर्धन, अणुजीवशास्र, जैविक कीड नियंत्रण व जीवाणू खते निर्मिती याकडे विशेष लक्ष देण्यात येत आहे.

text.en: To develop technology with integrated pest, disease and nutrient management to increase production for making agricultural production cost effective and sustainable. To develop post-harvest technology for minimizing post-harvest losses and production of value-added products. To design and develop farm implements and technology for mechanization of agriculture. To evaluate and modify technology for protected cultivation of flowers and vegetables.
text.mr: तसेच विद्यापीठाचे भूषण असलेली फुले-त्रिवेणी ही तिहेरी संकरीत गाय, तिची दुध देण्याची क्षमता, वातावरणाशी जुळवून घेण्याची क्षमता व स्निग्धता इतर संकरित गायींपेक्षा जास्त आहे.विद्यापीठाने विकसीत केलेले लक्ष्मी विळा, ज्योती कांदा रोप लागवड यंत्र, ज्योती लसूण घास कापणी यंत्र, ट्रॅक्टरचलित फुले सरीवरंबा बहुपीक टोकण यंत्र, ट्रॅक्टरचलित फुले ऊस आंतरमशागत यंत्र, पॉवरटिलरचलित फुले बहुपीक टोकण यंत्र, मनुष्यचलीत फुले भुईमूग शेंगा फोडणी आणि सफाई यंत्र, ट्रॅक्टरचलित फुले मोल नांगर, बैलचलीत फुले बहुपीक टोकण यंत्र, फुले सरीवरंबा बहुपीक टोकण यंत्र, ट्रॅक्टरचलित फुले ऊस आंतर मशागत यंत्र, मानवचलीत फुले ज्वारी काढणी यंत्र, मानवचलीत फुले औषधी बिया फोडणी यंत्र, विद्युतचलित फुले कडबा कुट्टी यंत्र, फुले पीव्हीसी भात लावणी चौकट व ट्रॅक्टरचलित ऊस बांधणी यंत्र या 35 सुधारित यंञे व औजारांमुळे शेतक-यांचे काबाड कष्ट कमी होवून मजुरांची बचत होत असल्याने शेतक-यांमध्ये ती लोकप्रिय आहेत.

text.en: Taking into consideration the availability of land, water and weather conditions and other existing resources, the university has concentrated its efforts to develop suitable technologies for dryland agriculture, irrigated farming as well as hi-tech agriculture. During the last 53 years, the University has developed about 39 different types of Farm Implements and Machineries for the ease of sowing, transplanting, burring, interculturing and harvesting operations on the farms and 270 improved / F1 hybrids varieties of field crops, forages, vegetables, horticultural and ornamental crops, cash crops, spices, aromatic and medicinal plants and also registered pure breeds of cattle-Khillar, goat-Osmanabadi & Sangamneri, sheep-Deccani and buffalo-Pandharpuri with NBAGR, Karnal, and one Phule Trivni cattle breed , etc. More than 1577 crop production technologies pertaining to agro-techniques, soil and water management, farming and cropping systems, integrated nutrient, water, pest, disease management, post harvest technology, farm machinery, etc are developed and recommended for productivity improvement. The university has focused its attention on location specific and need based research activities and also seed production and seedlings/saplings activities on large scale in order to cater the needs of all types of farmers and farming groups. Organic farming, crop diversification, development of transgenic and export oriented quality production and post harvest handling and process engineering are the priority areas to face the challenges of WTO regime. Biotechnology with its vast potential and challenges is important to agricultural development. This university is developing biotechnological competence in the areas of plant tissue culture, genetic engineering, molecular biology, and molecular characterization for IPR issues, biocontrol and biofertilizers.

text.en: The university has a very good network of 27 research stations spread over 5 different agro-climatic zones having 82 non-plan schemes funded by State Govt., 45 AICRPs on different crops /plant sciences and one Centrally Sponsored Research Schemes funded by the Central Govt., Ministry of Agriculture, where varietal development and technology verification of more than 100 crops (cereals, pulses, oilseeds, vegetable , cash crops protected cultivation , exotic vegetables and fruit crops) is being carried out. In addition to this management of natural resource management, development of integrated farming system model research is undertaken for the upliftment of resource poor farming community.
text.mr: पश्चिम महाराष्ट्रातील दहा जिल्हयांचा समावेश असलेले घाट विभाग, उप-पर्वतीय विभाग, मैदानी विभाग, अवर्षण प्रवण विभाग व मध्य महाराष्ट्रातील पठारी विभाग या 5 हवामान विभागात असलेली तृणधान्‍ये, कडधान्‍ये, गळीताची धान्‍ये, फळे-भाजीपाला, नगदी पिके, विदेशी भाजीपाला इत्‍यादी १०० हून अधिक पिकावर, मध्यवर्ती परिसरासह एकूण 27 संशोधन केंद्रावर असलेल्‍या राज्य शासन अनुदानित 82 योजनेतर योजना, भारतीय कृषि संशोधन परिषद (75 %) आणि राज्य शासन (25 %) अनुदानीत 45 अखिल भारतीय समन्वीत संशोधन प्रकल्प आणि केंद्र पुरस्कृत 100 टक्के अनुदानीत 1 संशोधन प्रकल्पामार्फत संशोधन केले जाते.
